messages.subject: Seewave problems with large files
messages.body_plain:
Hi, i'm trying to compute H and D index on a set of wav files i have.
My files are (on average) 150 Mb, 44.1 Khz, 16 bit
tuneR loads the file, but when i try to compute the H index, the
functions fails.
Any ideas ?
Thanks
Juan Ignacio

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Seewave problems with large files
messages.body_plain:
H and D indexes are partly based on the amplitude envelope and this
generates a new object with a similar size of your Sample or Wave
object. It means that you double the memory in use.

It is then highly probable that the amount of memory requested by R
exceeds your RAM memory.

Can't you decrease the size of your .wav files ? Are they mono or
stereo? Can't you downsample them?

Best

Jerome

messages.body_plain:
Hi,
My idea was to analize 30 min files, but when the error prompted, i
tried with a subset of my file of about 15 minutes, (size: 77.5 Mb).
The strange thing is that R gives the same vector size error with the
two files (big size and reduce one).

With 15 min file (77 MB)
=====================

> library(seewave)
Loading Tcl/Tk interface ... done
> library(tuneR)
> memory.limit()
[1] 1014
> a<-readWave("15min_sample.wav")
> memory.size()
[1] 313.97
> H(a)
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 302.8 Mb
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In as.vector(data) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In as.vector(data) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
3: In as.vector(data) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
4: In as.vector(data) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)

With 155 Mb file
=============
> library(seewave)
Loading Tcl/Tk interface ... done
> library(tuneR)
> memory.limit()
[1] 1014
> memory.size()
[1] 12.26
> b<-readWave("30min_sample.wav")
> memory.size()
[1] 616.72
> H(b)
Error: cannot allocate vector of size 302.8 Mb
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In inputw(wave = wave, f = f) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
2: In inputw(wave = wave, f = f) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
3: In inputw(wave = wave, f = f) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)
4: In inputw(wave = wave, f = f) :
  Reached total allocation of 1014Mb: see help(memory.size)

Thank's
Juan

and install seewave "manually" from the terminal with:
R CMD INSTALL seewave_1.5.7.tgz
but not sure this can be of any help...

rgl is an issue with linux. Could this also free the console? See  the
tab "Installation" of the seewave webpage for details and solution.

Best
Jerome

messages.subject: Re: [seewave] troubles with seewave or R???
messages.body_plain:
Dear Gerome,

 Thank you for your support. I have solved the problem. The console was frozen after calling the tcltk library, and checking another package I used to work with in a windows PC that uses tcl/tk interface confirmed it. I installed the Universal build of Tcl/Tk 8.5.5 for X11 (32-bit and 64-bit), which was lacking. Now everything is alright.

Thanks again.

Lazaro
